profile.headline: Software Architect | Engineering Manager
profile.summary:
Detail-oriented and goal-focused Software Engineer with success in solution architecting & leading development of innovative and on-demand software applications. Achieved excellence in identifying and resolving business and logical problems. Experience includes application design, legacy product migration, software deployment and leadership of developers in full life cycle project management, product ownership and quality assurance. Uses knowledge of the SDLC and Agile methodologies in continuous integration and delivery, stays abreast of emerging technologies and delivers concurrent projects on time. Applies an analytical approach to solve problems, cultivated trusted relationships with key stakeholders and is committed to operational excellence.

Programming: C#, .Net Core 2.2/3.1, MVC, ASP.NET, Web Forms, Entity Framework & Core, C, C++

Development: Angular, Node, jQuery, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Web API 2, SOAP/REST Web Services, ADO.NET, T-SQL, LINQ, Azure Devops, TFS, XML, Docker, Kubernetes, Graph QL, Hang fire, Objected Oriented Principles, Design Patterns, Architectural Principles

Azure Cloud: Database, Devops, CI/CD, VMs, Load Balancing, Blob Storage, App Insight Monitoring
AWS Cloud: AWS Services, Elastic BeanStalk, EC2, Lambda, S3 Storage, RDS

Databases: MS SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, MySQL

Tools: Visual Studio, SQL Reporting Server, SQL Server Integration Service, GIT, SVN, TFS, Jira

positions.title: Software Architect & Engineering Manager
positions.description:
As a hands-on technical leader, I drive the architecture, development, and continuous evolution of enterprise SaaS platforms, ensuring they meet business goals, customer needs, and strict security/compliance frameworks (SOC-II, GDPR, HIPAA). My role bridges deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, shaping product roadmaps, guiding engineering execution, and mentoring high-performing teams.

Key Contributions & Responsibilities:

Product & Technical Strategy: Defined long-term product and platform architecture aligned with business objectives; evaluated emerging technologies to influence stack choices, scalability, and maintainability.

Cloud-Native SaaS Leadership: Owned end-to-end architecture across Azure and AWS, implementing secure API ecosystems, microservices, and event-driven designs to support integrations and customer growth.

Engineering Management: Built and scaled distributed teams, driving Agile/DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and code quality standards. Mentored engineers through career development and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Security & Compliance: Led SOC-II readiness and vulnerability management programs, embedding secure coding practices, audit processes, and incident response strategies into the engineering lifecycle.

Solution Delivery: Oversaw the full SDLC, automated monitoring, and platform resilience strategies, ensuring high availability and reliability.

Impact Highlights:
- Designed and launched subscription-based multi-tenant SaaS platforms with complex account models and payment integrations (Stripe, Azure services).
- Successfully guided teams through SOC-II compliance programs, establishing security-first engineering culture.
- Modernized legacy solutions by implementing domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven architectures, and cloud-native modernization on Azure.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer & Software Service Manager
Strategic Infrastructure Support & Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: MS Azure, Team Lead, Product Ownership, Sprint Planning, C# .Net Core, MVC 5, MVC 5 -> .Net Core Plan, Entity Framework (DB First & Code First), GIT, Azure DevOps, jQuery, MS SQL, Rest & Web APIs, SQL Performance Optimization, LINQ, HTML, JavaScript, Bootstrap CSS, jQuery Upgrade, Upgrade to Bootstrap 5

# Worked with program managers & clients for business requirement gathering
# Analyzed requirements to decide whether it can be covered by platform functionality, or its enhancement, or workaround to existing functionalities and based on that provided delivery dates (Agile Scrum) and scope of the work with hour & cost estimation
# Defined technical solution and its alignment with other modules to ensure SaaS application platform 
# Performed software design review, code reviews and oversee technical delivery for multiple clients
# Worked with QA team aligning Sprint QA plan and converting common functionalities to automated testing using Selenium
# Documented and provided technical and architecture guidance on common platform functionalities and variance for different clients
# Worked on Infrastructure reorganization to accommodate highly scalable & easily deployable solution through DevOps pipelines

PROJECT: Prepared plan for migrating MVC to .Net Core
# Using .Net Portability Analyzer and strategy to use bottom to top with lowest dependency to more
# Retarget all cs projects to .Net Standard Library for first level of migration & later to actual .Net Core 6
# Prepared POC for the plan, analyzed risk and provided with solution and timeline for completion

PROJECT: Agile Process Implementation
# Provided knowledge and its benefits of using Agile/Scrum and helped improving process for development effectiveness

PROJECT: QA Team & Responsibility Alignment
# Guided QA team for using Azure DevOps test plan, provided knowledge on how to accommodate QA process in Agile sprint

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & Service Manager
positions.description:
Skill Utilized:
Skills Utilized: MS Azure, Team Lead, C# .Net Core, ASP.Net, MVC 5/6, Entity Framework, Docker, GraphQL, Hangfire, Stripe, TFS, GIT, JIRA, AJAX Toolkit, jQuery, Angular 7, MS SQL, SQL Reporting Server, Web Services, Rest APIs, ADO.Net, LINQ, HTML, JavaScript, Bootstrap CSS

# Worked on a statewide rollout project to support the existing application to enable State Medicaid staff to use the current system
# Directing a rollout project to accommodate state requirements and all nursing facilities in Ohio, which concludes 3K users and 1.6K transactions per week
# Utilized Azure to upgrade VMs, App Service Plans, implemented Load balancer and creating Application Insight Monitoring and Recovery plans to accommodate increased users and transactions and decreased the load on server by 30%
# Integrated the application with RingCentral to improve the tracking of faxes and consumed the RingCentral APIs using Angular 2 into .net web-form application under the infrastructure layer of application
# Using jQuery, AJAX calls and SQL Reporting Server to upgrade reports with a more graphical look, which includes export features and JSON data to improve time in search, short and in pagination through SQL Reporting Server
# Designed and developed 10 different reports to track contracts and invoicing to improve contract visibility for clients (http://contracturl.azurewebsites.net/Report/InvoiceSummary)
# Used Forte Rest APIs, Task Scheduler and Webhooks to implement subscription and online payment features (ACH / Credit Card) to facilitate a paperless Company environment
# Leading team of seven and utilizing JIRA and SCRUM to plan sprint and backlog tasks to balance the workload and product delivery
# Designed RESTful architecture for the On-Demand product, which included data-access, business logic, infrastructure and services layers, as well as design patterns such as Layered, Repository, Model Factory, MVC, Dependency Injection and Web API

projects.title: Task Tracker System
projects.description:
Skill Utilized: C# .Net Core, MS SQL, Entity Framework, Code-First, Layered Architecture, Repo Pattern, OOPS

#	Designed and developed a web application in order to understand the lifecycle and architecture of a .Net Core Application
#	Implemented layered architecture and applied OOPS fundamentals - Web Layer (concerns view models, razor pages, scripting), Data Access Layer (DB connection, DB entities and interfaces) and Service Layer (to meet business logic)
#	The system featured time spent on each task, the hours worked in a week and the number of tasks completed on time and improved communication over tasks by sharing information and media files
